subject: french
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in French on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (French↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: What does « un jeu de société » mean?
questions.explain: « Un jeu de société » means a board game (literally a game of company), not a society.

questions.q: What does 'faire de la randonnée' mean?
questions.explain: 'La randonnée' is 'hiking/rambling', so 'faire de la randonnée' = 'to go hiking'.
False friend: 'sensible' in French means 'sensitive'. 'Sensible' (English) would be 'raisonnable'.

questions.q: How would you write 'sportif' to describe a sporty woman?
questions.explain: Adjectives ending in -if change to -ive in the feminine singular, so a sporty woman is 'sportive'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We celebrate Christmas with the family'?
questions.explain: 'Fêter' = 'to celebrate' and 'en famille' = 'with the family', so 'On fête Noël en famille' is correct.

questions.q: How do you say 'I have brown hair and blue eyes'?
options: J'ai les cheveux bruns et les yeux bleus
J'ai les cheveux bleus et les yeux bruns
J'ai le cheveux brun et les yeux bleu
Je suis les cheveux bruns et les yeux bleus
questions.explain: Use 'avoir' for features and make adjectives agree (plural): 'les cheveux bruns', 'les yeux bleus'.
'Une vedette' means 'a star/celebrity'. ('Une fenêtre' is a window — a false-friend-style distractor.)

questions.q: How do you say 'I play football' (a sport)?
questions.explain: Sports take 'jouer à': 'Je joue au football'. Instruments take 'jouer de' (e.g. 'je joue du piano').

questions.q: What does « Ils se sont fiancés » mean?
questions.explain: « Se fiancer » means to get engaged, so « ils se sont fiancés » = they got engaged.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I spend too much time online'?
options: Je passe trop de temps en ligne
Je passe trop de temps en retard
Je passe peu de temps en ligne
questions.explain: 'Passer du temps' = 'to spend time' and 'trop de' = 'too much', so this means 'I spend too much time online'.
« Bricoler » means to do DIY or tinker with things; « le bricolage » is DIY.

questions.q: Which sentence means « I go out with my friends every weekend »?
options: Je sors avec mes amis tous les week-ends
Je sors avec mes amis tous les jours
Je reste avec mes amis tous les week-ends
Je sortais avec mes amis le week-end
questions.explain: « Je sors » (from « sortir ») = I go out and « tous les week-ends » = every weekend.

questions.q: How do you say 'I play the piano' (an instrument)?
questions.explain: Instruments take 'jouer de': 'Je joue du piano'. Using 'jouer à' would wrongly treat it like a sport.

questions.q: What does 'J'ai l'habitude de lire le soir' mean?
options: I used to read in the evening
I would like to read in the evening
I have to read in the evening
I usually read in the evening
questions.explain: 'Avoir l'habitude de' means 'to be in the habit of / usually do', so this is 'I usually read in the evening'.
